headline: 女版宿醉電影影評出爐
context: 《宿醉》編劇搭檔 Jon Lucas 與 Scott Moore 自編自導的新片《Spa Weekend》上映，由 Leslie Mann、Anna Faris、Isla Fisher 主演，講中年女性的奢華水療週末。有影評毫不留情，說它是「沒有笑點的喜劇」。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Despite stars Leslie Mann, Anna Faris and Isla Fisher and the writers behind The Hangover, this tale of friends at a luxury hotel is a dud Jon Lucas and Scott Moore are the screenwriters who struck gold nearly 20 years ago with The Hangover, a brilliant stag-weekend nightmare comedy about what happens in Vegas, which sadly spawned a terrible (though lucrative) franchise. Now, as writers and directors, they have tried turning it around and making a movie about how middle-aged women behave on a longed-for spa weekend at a luxury-porn hotel. The result is a comedy without gags, a comedy which, for all the strenuous high-jinks, is afraid to be flippant or mean or, indeed, funny in any way. Leslie Mann plays a hotshot lawyer called Jane who can’t make room in her life for romance; Anna Faris is goofy Sophie, PA to a rich asshole; Michelle Buteau is outspoken badass Coco, angry at her ex-husband dating again; and Isla Fisher is landed with the stridently unfunny role of Mel, a wild child who makes the other three nervous, but whose life-affirming no-filter honesty is going to break everyone’s emotional logjam and sort out their lives. As for Jane, it looks as if the hotel’s super-hot super-sensitive yoga teacher, Kai (Adam Demos), is going to hook up with her. Continue reading...

thread_text:
《宿醉》（The Hangover）編劇搭檔 Jon Lucas 與 Scott Moore 這次自編自導，把故事翻轉成中年女性的奢華水療週末——新片《Spa Weekend》由 Leslie Mann、Anna Faris 與 Isla Fisher 主演。影評反應不佳，有評論直言這是一部「沒有笑點的喜劇」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 8 月 21 日發佈的影評。
threads_text:
還記得《宿醉》（The Hangover）嗎？當年寫出這部單身漢惡夢喜劇的編劇搭檔 Jon Lucas 與 Scott Moore，這次自編自導，把公式反過來——拍一群中年女性期待已久的奢華水療週末。新片叫《Spa Weekend》，主演是 Leslie Mann、Anna Faris 和 Isla Fisher。不過影評不太買單，有評論毫不留情地說：這是一部沒有笑點的喜劇。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 8 月 21 日發佈的影評，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
voice_text: 《宿醉》的編劇搭檔拍了女版故事，影評不太買單。新片叫《Spa Weekend》，Jon Lucas 和 Scott Moore 自編自導，Leslie Mann、Anna Faris、Isla Fisher 主演——一群中年女性，期待已久的奢華水療週末。有影評直接說，這是一部「沒有笑點的喜劇」。這些是評論，觀點聽聽就好。
